checks.title: New-game entry and authored world
checks.procedure: From a fresh slot enter the production scene twice. Verify exactly one player, grid, camera, loader, dialogue, caster, monitor and save authority; begin at authored forest spawn.

checks.title: Required route and portal bounce
checks.procedure: Walk forest/campus/B01.Ground/B02.Ground/B04.Ground in both directions; record arrival cells, collision safety and no immediate bounce. Force unavailable destination/blocked arrival and verify previous area/cell restoration.

checks.title: Reserved room and expansion gates
checks.procedure: Try every reserved room/expansion entrance; verify blocked travel and readable unavailable feedback, without partial relocation or story-key bypass.

checks.title: First Light / Ampere
checks.procedure: Accept First Light; complete terminal lesson before solving. Verify locked spell before lesson, powered intended B02 relic only completes Active quest, unrelated target fails, success repeats grant nothing.

checks.title: String Them Together / Weave
checks.procedure: After First Light accept String; complete terminal lesson. Connect intended endpoints, verify source power/distance attenuation and minimum power; unrelated cable, unpowered source and moving apart fail. Recast/remove/retry and restore.

checks.title: Out of Alignment / Vis
checks.procedure: Accept and finish terminal lesson. Verify correct authored normalized rotation AND aligned state on intended marker; wrong angle/aligned-only/unrelated target fail; reset Active puzzle and retry.

checks.title: Cold Feet, Warm Idea / Glaciate
checks.procedure: After alignment complete terminal lesson. Traverse ordered traps within authored bounded lane; frozen flag or goal alone fails; wrong direction, blockers, safe exit, partial reset and mid-sequence save obey policy.

checks.title: Patch Notes / Rotara and Gravitate
checks.procedure: Accept Orio forest quest and finish terminal lesson before rotation. Verify quarter turns/wraparound, intended target angle, retry and restore; campus duplicate cannot complete forest quest. Record Gravitate lesson/target behavior if authored.

checks.title: Something Borrowed / Lost Echoes
checks.procedure: Complete Katrina terminal lesson. Reveal/search locally around intended keepsake, verify initial hidden/restored revealed state, unrelated reveal cannot complete, generic item reward exactly once.

checks.title: Receptionist, key mystery and Chapter 1 ending
checks.procedure: Record receptionist introduction and all four friend/six quest gates. Check contradictory key handover, key possession/locked dorm, return and sleep/wake; chapter-complete flag remains durable and repeated interaction is idempotent.

checks.title: Before/after-save restoration
checks.procedure: Record map/cell, quests, event/key/item flags, unlocked spells, object rotation/power/frozen/reveal/alignment and cables. Save before each lesson and during puzzles, reload and compare; completed quests remain complete after object reset.

checks.title: Missing/corrupt/incompatible saves
checks.procedure: Use copied test slots for missing, truncated/corrupt, incompatible version and migration fixtures. Verify actionable failure, recovery/backup policy, atomic write and provider rollback; never silently reset valid progress.

checks.title: Overlay and input ownership
checks.procedure: Open dialogue, wheel, journal, startup/settings in supported order. Verify movement/spell/interaction blocked, opening E cannot skip first node, close/cancel releases only its own lock, disable/re-enable cleans subscriptions.

checks.title: Grid bounds, footprints and diagonal corners
checks.procedure: Attempt edge exits, occupied footprints, diagonal corner cutting and blocked paths. Verify authoritative GridWorld rejection and no overlap during portal arrival/NPC movement.

checks.title: Rendering, camera, settings and navigation
checks.procedure: On target device verify names/props/signage, camera teleport/interior bounds/occlusion restoration, text scale/contrast/read speed/reduced motion, long choices/scrolling and keyboard/gamepad focus. Persist settings and restart.

checks.title: Audio contexts and saved mix
checks.procedure: Verify approved forest/campus/interior/dialogue/mystery/sleep-wake media, spell/step/UI/quest cues, volume persistence and no invalid assets. Record unavailable approved assets as fail or blocked, not pass.

checks.title: Measured performance and diagnostic overhead
checks.procedure: Capture cold/warm activation of every required map, map rebuild/object effects/loading and NPC pathfinding with diagnostics disabled/enabled. Record target hardware, scenario/capture paths and approved mean/max budgets for each metric; include representative stress/retry cases.

checks.title: Licensed target build and final device smoke test
checks.procedure: Build exact full commit with Unity 6000.4.10f1 for each declared target platform under licensed acceptance. Record build identifier, device/OS, log/capture evidence and complete this matrix on the built player; offline compilation is insufficient.
